verdict.rationale: The evidence shows incident.io has Workflows (automations) and a first-party Terraform provider being built out 'resource by resource'. Nothing documents version history, review/approval, or rollback for workflows, and nothing confirms the Terraform provider covers workflows. Any versioning, review or rollback through Terraform and git would be a user-side arrangement, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
